archetypes.title: Part-whole map
archetypes.honesty: Parts must belong to one named whole. Do not invent extra parts.
archetypes.notes: One object and the pieces that make it. Containment, not length share.

archetypes.title: Nested layers
archetypes.honesty: Layer order is a claim. Label what sits on what.
archetypes.notes: Stacked containment or privilege.

archetypes.title: Node-link tree
archetypes.honesty: One parent per child. A node with two parents is a graph, not this form.
archetypes.notes: Hierarchy or fan-out from one root. Tree ≠ graph.

archetypes.title: Node-link graph
archetypes.honesty: Edges are relations. Shared children and cross edges are allowed. Do not draw a tree and call it a graph.
archetypes.notes: General network or DAG. Tree ≠ graph.

archetypes.title: Stack frames
archetypes.honesty: LIFO is the claim. Top of stack must be marked. Do not encode a call stack as an index tape.
archetypes.notes: Call frames. Stack ≠ tape.

archetypes.title: Number line
archetypes.honesty: A CPA pictorial bridge, not a destination. Do not use a number line as the only encoding for a graph.
archetypes.notes: Hops on a marked line. Bridge to a congruent form.

archetypes.title: Coordinate figure
archetypes.honesty: Vertex coordinates are claims. Do not drop the axes.
archetypes.notes: A figure on a metric plane.

archetypes.title: Free body
archetypes.honesty: Each arrow is a named force on one body. Do not add decorative arrows.
archetypes.notes: Force/vector diagram.

archetypes.title: Flow sequence
archetypes.honesty: Order is the claim. Do not imply duration unless labeled. A return edge belongs on cycle-return, not here.
archetypes.notes: One path of ordered steps.

archetypes.title: Cycle loop
archetypes.honesty: A cycle needs a named return. Do not hide the exit. Do not use a linear chevron for a loop.
archetypes.notes: A process that returns to a prior step.

archetypes.title: State steps
archetypes.honesty: Each box is a state. Arrows are events. Do not mix the two.
archetypes.notes: Discrete states and the events that move between them.

archetypes.title: Pipeline stages
archetypes.honesty: A stage consumes the prior output. Do not skip a handoff. Index cells are not call frames.
archetypes.notes: Work that moves through named stages. Tape ≠ stack.

archetypes.title: Timeline
archetypes.honesty: Position encodes time. Do not use unordered chevrons when duration is the claim.
archetypes.notes: Events on a duration axis.

archetypes.title: Pathway map
archetypes.honesty: Each arrow is a named conversion. Do not collapse a mechanism into unlabeled chevrons.
archetypes.notes: Process or pathway with a side branch.

archetypes.title: Proof steps
archetypes.honesty: Every statement names a justification. Do not leave a reason blank.
archetypes.notes: Justification-column grammar.

archetypes.title: Side by side
archetypes.honesty: Align the same attribute on one row. Do not compare unlike fields.
archetypes.notes: Two or three cases on one aligned frame.

archetypes.title: Before after
archetypes.honesty: Only one change should differ unless you label each change.
archetypes.notes: One object at two times.

archetypes.title: Shared grid
archetypes.honesty: Empty cells are claims. Do not hide a missing value as decoration. This is a matrix, not two side-by-side frames.
archetypes.notes: Cases by attributes in one table. Novick matrix.

archetypes.title: Magnitude scale
archetypes.honesty: Bar length must match the number. Do not decorate past the value. Header boxes are not a magnitude encoding.
archetypes.notes: How large one quantity is against a common scale. Cleveland and McGill.

archetypes.title: Part of whole share
archetypes.honesty: Shares must sum to the whole you named. Length encodes share. Nested boxes are not this form.
archetypes.notes: How a quantity splits inside one whole.

archetypes.title: Distribution strip
archetypes.honesty: Dots, bins, or the box sit on one scale. Do not use area as the quantity.
archetypes.notes: A sample on a common scale.

archetypes.title: Bound region
archetypes.honesty: The bound is the claim. Mark inside and outside.
archetypes.notes: A legal region and what sits outside it.

archetypes.title: Allowed vs blocked
archetypes.honesty: Show both the allowed path and the blocked path.
archetypes.notes: A rule that permits one move and forbids another.

archetypes.title: Break point
archetypes.honesty: Name the failed relation. Do not only show a red mark.
archetypes.notes: The structure after one relation fails.

archetypes.title: Overflow spill
archetypes.honesty: Capacity and the excess must both be visible.
archetypes.notes: A container that cannot hold what arrived.

archetypes.title: Analog carry
archetypes.honesty: Map only the relations that hold. Label the break if the analog fails. Dual panels without cross-map edges are not this form.
archetypes.notes: A known structure mapped onto a new one.

archetypes.title: Worked map
archetypes.honesty: Keep the first example in view while the second appears.
archetypes.notes: The same move on a second instance.
